results.title: Grafton to consider allowing on-site marijuana consumption; public feedback sessions ahead
results.description: Like many towns across Massachusetts, Grafton is considering allowing on-site consumption of marijuana. On July 21, Annette Garcia – the public health director for Shrewsbury, Grafton, and West Boylston – led the Select Board in a discussion about potential options going forward.

results.title: Constitution Review: Government outlines roadmap for implementation
results.description: The government is set to establish a Constitution Review Implementation Committee to oversee the next phase of the constitutional amendment process following its decision on some recommendations submitted by the Constitution Review Committee.

results.title: Meta CEO Mark ​Zuckerberg apologises to Indian government
results.description: NEW DELHI: A parliamentary committee demanded that Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg personally apologise for temporarily removing a Facebook video of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
